goblin_lord.name: The Goblin Lord

canon_ref.note: Leads the army that marches north past Liscor (4.32 G). A Hob of ordinary Human size in black robes, black eyes with white pupils; rides a huge Shield Spider (4.46). He takes the name Reiss from the dying Zel (4.49): flag goblin_lord.named_reiss. Class name and level not given.

goblin_lord.summary: The Goblin Lord whose black-armoured army crosses Izril. Not a big warrior, but a caster with a black blade Skill and loyal lieutenants. The world blames him for Zel Shivertail's death.

snapjaw.name: Snapjaw

canon_ref.note: A former Chieftain (4.46). A short female Hob with a big head and two rows of steel-fused teeth, crimson eyes, steel armour; rides horses (4.48). Survives Book 6.

snapjaw.summary: One of the Goblin Lord's lieutenants, who bites through armour with metal teeth. She leads his riders at Invrisil and lives through Zel's last fight.

eater_of_spears.name: Eater of Spears

canon_ref.note: A former Chieftain (4.46). A huge Hob about seven feet tall with skin that breaks lances (4.48). Badly hurt by Zel and a War Golem in 4.49; his fate is not stated.

eater_of_spears.summary: The Goblin Lord's giant lieutenant, who takes lances on his chest and wrestles a War Golem to save his Lord. Zel and the golems leave him torn open.

eggsnatcher.name: Eggsnatcher

canon_ref.note: A former Chieftain (4.46) who commands a horde of spiders and rides a giant Shield Spider (4.48). No death shown; alive is a guess.

eggsnatcher.summary: The Goblin Lord's [Beastmaster] lieutenant, who rides a giant Shield Spider. At Invrisil he traps the Human cavalry and duels Reynold's carriage.

noface.name: Noface

canon_ref.note: Seen as a Goblin with no face in 4.46, named in 4.48. A former Chieftain who casts fire. Zel kills him in 4.48.

noface.summary: A faceless Goblin lieutenant who throws fire for the Goblin Lord. Zel kills him at Invrisil and shows his head to the Goblins.

illbreath.name: Illbreath

canon_ref.note: Named in 4.48. He swallowed a poison-making artifact and breathes poison. Zel tears his head off in 4.48.

illbreath.summary: A Hob lieutenant of the Goblin Lord whose breath is poison. He falls to Zel Shivertail at Invrisil.

wirclaw.name: Wirclaw

canon_ref.note: Dirty-blonde fur, a Fischer Cow bite scar, a good bow (4.33, 4.34). Krshia buys his milk. His small son is not named.

wirclaw.summary: A strong Gnoll [Farmer] near Liscor who sells milk from his cows, Fischer Cows and goats. He holds his walled village against the Eater Goats with Erin.

maviss.name: Maviss

canon_ref.note: Light pinkish-red scales (4.36 O).

maviss.summary: A Drake [Receptionist] at Liscor's Adventurers' Guild who deals with Olesm and the teams going into the dungeon.

purple_smile.name: Purple Smile

canon_ref.note: A painted Soldier: a purple ring round both eyes and a smile drawn across his mandibles (4.40 L). Leads the surface patrols; Pawn makes him a [Sergeant] at the end of 4.42 L (set by that event, not here).

purple_smile.summary: A relaxed, painted Antinium Soldier who leans on walls and fights like a chess Knight, flanking instead of charging. He becomes one of Pawn's [Sergeants].

twin_stripes.name: Twin Stripes

canon_ref.note: A pink stripe on each side of his face (4.40 L). Turns Aberration, is chained, and is calmed by Pawn's [Benediction of Hope] (4.42 L).

twin_stripes.summary: A painted Soldier who goes Aberration and attacks Yellow Splatters. Chained in a cell, he is brought back by Pawn's prayer.

falene_skystrall.name: Falene Skystrall

canon_ref.note: Arrives in 4.43, named in 4.45. Light red hair, a staff; looks late twenties but is far older. A generalist [Mage] who recently took the [Battlemage] path; left Wistram about 30 years ago. From Terandria is a guess.

falene_skystrall.summary: The Silver Swords' Half-Elf mage, polite, proud and old-fashioned. She looks down on Ceria and Pisces.

dawil.name: Dawil

canon_ref.note: Of the Ironbreaker clan, part Human; a few inches over five feet, thick beard, dark brown hair, full plate and a hammer (4.43, 4.45). About ten years older than Ylawes. Class not named; from Terandria is a guess.

dawil.summary: The Silver Swords' loud, hungry Dwarf with a hammer, who lectures on smithing he hates. He spots that Erin's coin is mithril.

geram_redfist.name: Geram Redfist

canon_ref.note: Lady Rie's captain of the guard: bald, a former [Street Brawler], fights with gauntlets (4.35 E). Race not stated (Human is a guess); home follows Rie's.

geram_redfist.summary: Lady Rie's tough, bald captain of the guard, who fights with his fists.

nesor.name: Nesor

canon_ref.note: Rie's [Mage]; he did not finish at Wistram (4.35 E). Race not stated (Human is a guess).

nesor.summary: Lady Rie's young [Mage], who failed at Wistram and now serves her household.

nalthal.name: Nalthal

canon_ref.note: Full name Nalthaliarstrelous. Called an old man (Human is a guess). His garden maze hides two War Golems and the Heartflame Breastplate (4.44 M).

nalthal.summary: Magnolia's rude, smelly [Gardener], who is really a [Druid]. His maze at the Reinhart estate hides her War Golems.

bekia.name: Bekia

canon_ref.note: Seen in 4.38 B and 4.44 M.

bekia.summary: A Gnoll [Maid] who has served in Magnolia Reinhart's household for years.

sir_evimore.name: Sir Evimore

canon_ref.note: A Knight of the Petal under Lady Bethal. The Goblin Lord kills him with three [Deathbolts] while Goblins hold him down (4.48).

sir_evimore.summary: One of Lady Bethal's Rose Knights, killed by the Goblin Lord's death magic at Invrisil.

welca_caveis.name: Welca Caveis

canon_ref.note: A Rose Knight in training. Pyrite holds her under the lake but she lives (4.39 G). Race not stated (Human is a guess).

welca_caveis.summary: A young Rose Knight in training who nearly drowns in Pyrite's grip when Rags drives off Bethal's knights.

gershal.name: Gershal

canon_ref.note: From Vaunt, a cheese town (4.47). First officer to pledge to Zel; holds the line in 4.48 and carries Salvia away in 4.49.

gershal.summary: A [Lieutenant] from Vaunt, the first to follow Zel Shivertail against the Goblin Lord. He survives Invrisil.

salvia.name: Salvia

canon_ref.note: A cavalry [Captain] from Nonelmar with [Scatter Gallop] (4.47). Her mount dies in 4.49 and Gershal carries her off; alive is a guess.

salvia.summary: The cavalry [Captain] from Nonelmar who rides with Zel at Invrisil.

hethon_veltras.name: Hethon Veltras

canon_ref.note: Tyrion's older son, quiet; seen in the frame of the Pt. 5 history reading.

hethon_veltras.summary: Tyrion Veltras's quiet older son, who listens before he speaks.

sammial_veltras.name: Sammial Veltras

canon_ref.note: Tyrion's younger son, about 9 or 10, sickly; wants to be called Sammy (Pt. 5 frame).

sammial_veltras.summary: Tyrion Veltras's sickly, lively younger son, who hears the Antinium Wars read aloud.

ullim.name: Ullim

canon_ref.note: His family has served House Veltras for six generations; he reads the history book to the boys (Pt. 5 frame).

ullim.summary: The Veltras [Majordomo], who reads Krsysl's history aloud to Tyrion's sons.

blighted_king.name: The Blighted King

canon_ref.note: Not named. Old; his sword is Blightbane; his steward slows his ageing. The Fool stabs him in 1.05 C and he lives. The Fool says his summoning cost ten thousand unborn.

blighted_king.summary: The ruler of the Blighted Kingdom who summoned Tom's group. Ruthless for his war on the Demons.

blighted_queen.name: The Blighted Queen

canon_ref.note: Not named. Very tall, about thirty, a black obsidian mace; a famed warrior before her marriage. Race not stated (Human is a guess).

blighted_queen.summary: The Blighted King's warrior Queen, mother of Princess Erille.

erille.name: Princess Erille

canon_ref.note: A young girl, daughter of the current Queen. Tom saves her from two Demon assassins (1.03 C).

erille.summary: The Blighted King's young daughter, whom Tom saves from Demon assassins.

isodore.name: Princess Isodore

canon_ref.note: About sixteen, daughter of the previous Queen, a dark-metal circlet. Six Demons wait at her door; she lives. First chapter is a guess (1.03 C – 1.05 C).

isodore.summary: The Blighted King's older daughter, who lives through the night of the Demon attack.

nereshal.name: Nereshal

canon_ref.note: The King's steward; a [Chronomancer] who slows the King's ageing. Short, grey robes lined with silver, scarred arms. The Fool turns his own lightning on him (1.05 C); alive is a guess.

nereshal.summary: The Blighted King's steward and time mage, struck down by his own lightning when the Fool betrays the court.

the_fool.name: The Fool

canon_ref.note: The court jester for over ten years, a small man in loud colours (race a guess). Copies objects, juggles spells, keeps a trick space. Let the Demons in. Tom burns him with his own fireball (1.05 C).

the_fool.summary: The Blighted King's jester, secretly a traitor in love with a Demon mage. Tom kills him with a fireball from the Fool's own trick space.

xersia.name: Lady Xersia

canon_ref.note: Called the Scorpion; a former Named Adventurer with a spear. The Demon mage teleports her into the sky and she falls to her death (1.05 C). First chapter is a guess.

xersia.summary: A spear-fighting [Marchioness] of Rhir, once a Named Adventurer, killed by a Demon mage's teleport.

cirille_bitterclaw.name: Cirille Bitterclaw

canon_ref.note: An Oldblood Drake with black scales and small useless wings; commands a Drake company serving in Rhir. Seen again at the court in 4.47. First chapter is a guess.

cirille_bitterclaw.summary: The Drake [Commander] of a company serving the Blighted King.

kirust.name: Captain Kirust

canon_ref.note: Dark skin, a scar on his temple; saw Tom's massacre at the village of Rastfad. First chapter is a guess.

kirust.summary: A [Captain] of the Blighted Kingdom who saw what Tom did at Rastfad.

yebior.name: Lord Yebior

canon_ref.note: Big, bearded, a scimitar. Alive is a guess; first chapter is a guess.

yebior.summary: A big, bearded [Lord] at the Blighted King's court.

keith.name: Keith

canon_ref.note: One of about twenty Earthers left of the sixty-odd summoned (1.02 C). Was an engineering student.

keith.summary: An Earther in Richard's group in Rhir, now a [Blacksmith].

chole.name: Chole

canon_ref.note: One of about twenty Earthers left of the sixty-odd summoned (1.02 C).

chole.summary: An Earther in Richard's group in Rhir who works as a [Nurse].

eddy.name: Eddy

canon_ref.note: One of about twenty Earthers left of the sixty-odd summoned (1.02 C). Talks a lot and knows games.

eddy.summary: A talkative Earther in Richard's group in Rhir.

vincent.name: Vincent

canon_ref.note: One of about twenty Earthers left of the sixty-odd summoned (1.02 C).

vincent.summary: An Earther in Richard's group in Rhir.

cynthia.name: Cynthia

canon_ref.note: One of about twenty Earthers left of the sixty-odd summoned (1.02 C). Terrified of Tom.

cynthia.summary: An Earther in Richard's group in Rhir who is afraid of Tom.
